title: Friday festival program cover
slide_intent: Show how a publication can tell someone which program to pick up at a glance. Giving the day and date most of the cover lets edition information carry the composition.
strategic_value: The festival can connect a practical timetable to its larger identity. The cyan date and striped lettering recall the campaign, while the small signature identifies the organizer.
demonstration: A hand holds a black program at an angle. Large cyan lettering gives Friday, 8 July and 2022 the dominant area. Thin parallel cuts interrupt the strokes. White marks and a FESTIVAL PROGRAM label sit below.
practical_value: Use this cover when deciding which words to enlarge on a daily program. The edition date leads, and the publication label remains readable in a separate corner.

content_islands.name: Hand-held publication
content_islands.spec: Retain the photographic frame and diagonal booklet. The hand establishes scale and partially overlaps the artwork.

content_islands.name: Date field
content_islands.spec: Stack the weekday, day and month, and year across the black cover in large cyan capitals and numerals. Let the thin cuts in the letterforms echo the animated campaign.

content_islands.name: Publication identifiers
content_islands.spec: Place the compact white festival signature in the lower left of the cover and the white two-line publication label at lower right. Leave a black band between these identifiers and the date.
